name: MediPlaza Los Algodones
summary: MediPlaza Los Algodones is a specialized medical tourism center located two blocks from the U.S.-Mexico border, offering comprehensive dental, optical, stem cell, and surgical services at significant savings compared to U.S. prices. The facility provides a complete Medical Hospitality experience with on-site dining, shopping, pharmacy services, and hotel accommodations for international patients and their companions.
demographics: MediPlaza Los Algodones primarily serves medical tourists from the United States and Canada, particularly retirees and seniors aged 55+ seeking affordable healthcare services. The visitor base includes middle-income households looking to save 50-70% on dental, optical, and medical procedures compared to U.S. prices. The trade area extends across the U.S.-Mexico border, with most visitors being day-trippers from Arizona and California who cross the border specifically for medical appointments and return the same day.
description: MediPlaza Los Algodones is a unique medical tourism center located just two blocks from the U.S.-Mexico border in Vicente Guerrero, Baja California. This specialized facility has positioned itself as the premier destination for affordable, high-quality medical care in Los Algodones, often called "Molar City" due to its concentration of dental clinics. The plaza offers a comprehensive Medical Hospitality experience, combining world-class healthcare services with dining, shopping, and lodging amenities all in one convenient location. Anchor tenants include Sani Dental Group offering up to 70% savings on dental work, GIOSTAR Mexico for advanced stem cell therapy, 20/20 Vision Center for optical services, and Sani Medical for surgical procedures. Beyond medical services, visitors can enjoy authentic Mexican cuisine at Mi Casa Es Su Casa, grab coffee at My Daily Treat, shop at One Stop Mini Mart and Pharmacy, and even stay overnight at the on-site Hotel Cielito Lindo. The center's mission focuses on delivering excellence in medical tourism while providing companions with entertainment and comfort during their visit. With its strategic border location and integrated approach to medical travel, MediPlaza has become a cornerstone in Los Algodones' reputation as a competitive medical tourism destination worldwide.
